title: Deployment & Hosting
subtitle: Ship your app to the world — DNS, SSL, servers, CDNs, and production operations for every stack
description: Deployment is where code becomes a product. This course covers every layer of the deployment stack: how DNS resolves your domain, how SSL certificates secure connections, how to host frontend apps, backend APIs, and databases — from free platforms like Vercel and Railway to self-managed VPS servers with Nginx. You'll leave knowing exactly how to get any application running in production and how to keep it there.
